title: Design System: Canovelles Bàsquet Club · Opció 3

display.purpose: Hero headline and pre-registration page title only; Anybody 850 at 112% width.

headline.purpose: Section h2s; the finder and final CTA run up to 64px and 72px.

title.purpose: Stage cards, values, detail-card group name, form legends; 100% width at card level.

label.purpose: Group chips, detail-card terms, notes; sentence case.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Buttons (lift 2px) and stage cards (lift 4px) on hover only.

shadows.name: card-on-field
shadows.purpose: White detail card sitting on the Court Blue finder field.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Form field focus, with a Court Blue border.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1 + translateY(14px) to 0 over 0.9s, stagger 90ms

motion.name: paint
motion.purpose: Court lines drawing themselves as their group enters, once.

motion.name: route
motion.purpose: Court finder route from the rim to the selected group; the ball moves and rolls on the same 0.9s.

motion.name: button
motion.purpose: Button hover lift and inset line widening.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reveal, paint, route, ball and button transitions disabled; content and lines shown in their final state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default painted button in Deep Zone with an inset line; the main pre-registration call.
components.css: .ds-btn{--btn-bg:#c94419;--btn-fg:#fff;--btn-line:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55);position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 22px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--btn-bg);color:var(--btn-fg);font:700 17px/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;isolation:isolate;transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow .4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:5px;border:2px solid var(--btn-line);border-radius:3px;pointer-events:none;transition:inset .4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-btn svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgb(15 27 61 / 0.08),0 14px 32px -12px rgb(15 27 61 / 0.3)}.ds-btn:hover::after{inset:3px}.ds-btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}.ds-btn:active{transform:none;box-shadow:none}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffd23f;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The site is the floor of the Pavelló Municipal de Canovelles seen from above. Every section is a whole field of one synthetic-floor colour (court blue, zone orange, outer green, ink, or the pale grey floor), and the only ornament is what a multisport floor actually carries: painted lines with round ends, keys, free-throw arcs, the centre circle, the rim and backboard. Structure is conventional (header, hero, sections, footer), so parents on a phone never have to learn the page; the character comes from colour used at full field scale and from lines that paint themselves in.

Density is relaxed and sporty: large Anybody headlines stretched wide, short Hanken Grotesk paragraphs capped around 44-46ch, generous section padding. Photos are real club photos, cropped square-cornered to the 6px base radius or run full bleed (the club family photo). The hero sets the photo inside a painted key: an orange lane on court blue with yellow lane hash marks and the free-throw semicircle outside the lane. Motion has one grammar: lines paint along their length (stroke-dashoffset) and content rises 14px, both on the same exponential ease-out, once, and not at all under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Whole sections as flat court-colour fields; no gradients, no textures.
Painted lines (2-5px, round caps) as the only ornament: keys, arcs, centre circles, sidelines.
Anybody wide (112% width) for display; Hanken Grotesk for everything read.
Buttons are painted rectangles with an inset line, like a zone marked on the floor.
One motion grammar: lines paint, content rises 14px, ease cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

rules.name: The Whole Field Rule
rules.body: A floor colour is used as an entire section or card field, never as a small accent dot on grey. If a colour appears, it owns its area.

rules.name: The Yellow Is Paint Rule
rules.body: Line Yellow is for lines, focus, selection and the one yellow button; it is never a section background.

rules.name: The Wide Voice Rule
rules.body: Width 112% is for page and section headlines; card-level titles drop back to 100% so they fit narrow fields.

rules.name: The Flat Floor Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a shadow means "this responds to you" or "this card is lifted off the court".

dos: **Do** give each section one whole floor colour (court, zone, outer-deep, ink, or floor) and keep its content inside that field.
**Do** draw ornament only from real court markings, as round-capped strokes (2-5px) that paint in via stroke-dashoffset when entering the viewport.
**Do** use Deep Zone for the default button and white text; use the Line button on blue or orange fields.
**Do** reveal content by rising 14px over 0.9s on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), staggered 90ms, once; switch all of it off under prefers-reduced-motion.
**Do** soften text on coloured fields with a tinted mist colour (court-mist, outer-mist), not opacity.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, textures or glow; the floor is flat paint.
**Don't** make Line Yellow a section background or body text colour on the floor.
**Don't** add shadows to surfaces at rest; shadow is hover feedback or the one card lifted off the court.
**Don't** use white body text on Zone Orange; on that field body text is ink and only the large headline is white.
**Don't** redraw or recolour the club crest; it sits on the Floor Grey header and the Ink footer as supplied.
